Telegram Cloud Storage

A desktop file manager whose storage is a private Telegram channel. Files are split into checked pieces; a local SQLite index remembers where each piece is.

Tauri (Rust)React + TailwindPython · FastAPISQLite (WAL)Telethon

Where it stands

Works and is testedDatabase, chunking, checksums, upload and download, deletes, index recovery, the local API and its guard, the whole interface in a browser. 158 automated tests, all passing in CI.
Not run against real TelegramThere are no Telegram credentials in the build environment. The Telegram layer is tested against a fake client. Expect small fixes on first contact with a real account.

The demo

A live recording of the real interface and backend: browsing, creating a folder, a multi-part upload with progress, drag and drop, a verified download, a confirmed delete, and the connection screen. It uses a local folder as the storage backend, not real Telegram, and its captions say so.

The interface

How a file travels

If a step fails during upload, the chunks already sent are deleted again and nothing is written to the index.

What is stored

In SQLite

folders      id, name, parent_id → folders (cascade), created_at
files        id, uid, folder_id → folders (cascade), file_name,
             file_size, mime_type, sha256_hash, total_chunks, uploaded_at
file_chunks  id, file_id → files (cascade), chunk_index, chunk_size,
             telegram_file_id, telegram_message_id

WAL mode, foreign keys on, every foreign key indexed. uid is the one column added to your specification.

In every Telegram caption

{
  "app": "tgcs",
  "v": 1,
  "fid": "3f9c0a7e51d84b2f9a6c1e2d7b8a4c90",
  "i": 2,
  "n": 4,
  "sha": "9b74c9897bac770ffc029102a200c5de9b74c9897bac770ffc029102a200c5de",
  "csha": "5e884898da28047151d0e56f8dc629275e884898da28047151d0e56f8dc62927",
  "name": "Project backup.zip",
  "size": 8392225,
  "mime": "application/zip"
}

Shown formatted; it is sent as compact JSON. This is what lets the index be rebuilt from the channel alone if the local database is lost.

Rules the code keeps

Nothing half-saved

The index is written only after every chunk is stored. A failed or cancelled upload deletes what it sent.

Corruption is refused

A flipped bit, a missing, reordered or short chunk fails the checksum. The partial file is deleted, never delivered.

Flood limits are waited out

On FLOOD_WAIT_X it sleeps X+1 seconds and retries; network errors back off. The interface shows the wait.

The local API is locked

Loopback only, a secret token on every request, Host and Origin checks, size caps while streaming. No other website can use it.

Secrets stay private

The API hash, bot token and login session are stored owner-only and never sent back by the API.

Starts offline

Connecting to Telegram has a timeout and runs in the background, so the window always opens.

How it is tested

SuiteTestsCovers
Backend (pytest)124WAL, foreign keys, indexes, cascades; chunk edges (empty, exact multiples); bit-flip, swapped, missing and short chunks; flood-wait and backoff; a fake Telethon client; upload cleanup on failure and cancel; recovery; the API guard; secrets never echoed.
Interface logic (vitest)15Size and date formatting, file kinds, folders-first natural sort, the folder tree.
Browser (Playwright)11Folders, multi-part upload with progress and a byte-for-byte download, drag and drop, name clashes, delete with confirmation, sorting, search, keyboard, no foreign requests, no sideways scroll.
Rust (rustc)8The process module: free port, token, waiting for the service, passing the environment, stopping the child.

Each protection was switched off in turn to confirm a test fails. That found two tests that passed anyway, and both were strengthened.

Limits to know about

  • Files are not encrypted by this app. They sit in your channel as Telegram stores any cloud chat. Do not store anything you would not put in a private channel.
  • Telegram's rules apply. Heavy automated storage may be rate-limited or restricted. Treat it as convenience storage, not your only backup.
  • No rename or move yet, and folders cannot be dragged in (drop the files inside).
  • Bot-token mode needs the bot to be an admin of the channel and able to find it; a public @username is the reliable way.
  • Downloads use the web view's own save handling, which differs by platform.

What comes next

  • Connect a real account. Get an API id and hash at my.telegram.org, run npm run tauri dev, sign in, and upload one small file. This is the first real test of the Telegram layer.
  • Package the backend as an executable (PyInstaller) so a release build works without Python installed.
  • Client-side encryption before upload, so the channel only ever holds ciphertext.
  • Rename and move, folder upload, resumable uploads.
